brief: How to build an email funnel that converts at 9%.

slots.title: PICK ONE PROBLEM
slots.body: Stop trying to solve everything at once. Pick a painful problem and build a lead magnet that promises a quick win. Specificity sells.

slots.title: NAIL THE WELCOME
slots.body: Your first email sets the vibe. Share your story, set expectations, and give them a tiny win. Make it impossible to ignore.

slots.title: SEGMENT YOUR LIST
slots.body: Not everyone wants the same thing. Tag subscribers based on clicks and interests. Send the right offer to the right inbox.

slots.title: LEAD WITH VALUE
slots.body: Sell only after you have earned trust. Share quick tips, stories, and case studies for free. Be the expert they remember.

slots.title: PITCH WITH CONFIDENCE
slots.body: When it is time to sell, do not apologize. State the transformation, add urgency, and keep the CTA crystal clear. One click only.

slots.title: TEST AND OPTIMIZE
slots.body: Open rates matter, but revenue matters more. Test subject lines, send times, and offers weekly. Small tweaks create big jumps.
